The idea is simple: a warrant the association renews after lesson audits, and that falcon alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the voyage compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The vine is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
